revisions.reason: read-only support research write topology gate contract

items.text: `beacon-brainstorm`, `beacon-context-engineering`, `beacon-source-driven`, `beacon-doubt-review`, `beacon-security-review`, `beacon-performance-review`, `beacon-documentation-adr`, `beacon-debug-recovery`, `beacon-ceo-review`, and `beacon-design-review` write version+feature findings into `docs/beacon/<version>/research/<feature>.md`.
`beacon-deep` writes detailed artifacts into `docs/beacon/<version>/deep/<feature>/` and `.machine/deep/<feature>/`; the research file stores only `Deep Summary` index metadata.
`beacon-learn` writes learning audit data into `docs/beacon/<version>/learning/<feature>.md` or support transaction; the research file stores only `Learning Influence Summary`.
`docs/brainstorms/` is not a default target for explicit Beacon version+feature support analysis.
Repeated support clarification in the same version appends rounds or supersedes owned sections in the same research file instead of creating sibling files.
Cross-version clarification creates a new version research file with lineage fields for previous research, carried-forward findings, and superseded assumptions.
Gate / requirement clarity blocks invalid support write topology and reports source skill, expected path, actual path, and repair route.
Read-only support output is not persisted until Beacon determines the write target from version, feature, and support surface class; unresolved routing fails closed instead of using legacy fallback.
Implement current frozen revision

Verify AC-006 — Cross-version clarification creates a new version research file with lineage fields for previous research, carried-forward findings, and superseded assumptions.
Verify AC-007 — Gate / requirement clarity blocks invalid support write topology and reports source skill, expected path, actual path, and repair route.

architecture: Ordinary support review surfaces write one owned section in `research/<feature>.md`.
`beacon-deep` writes detailed artifacts in `deep/<feature>/`; research stores only `Deep Summary`.
`beacon-learn` writes learning audit in `learning/<feature>.md` or transaction; research stores only `Learning Influence Summary`.
If the gate cannot prove `version`, `feature`, and support surface class, persistence is blocked before any file write.
decision_priority: Version-bound and feature-bound support output must use governed feature topology.
Ordinary support review must upsert one section in `research/<feature>.md`.
`docs/brainstorms/` is not a fallback target. It is allowed only for unbound scratch, external analysis, or explicit scratch output.
`beacon-deep` owns detailed deep artifacts; research only indexes them.
`beacon-learn` owns learning audit; research only summarizes learning influence.
Repeated clarification in the same version appends rounds or supersedes prior section content; it does not generate sibling files.
Cross-version clarification creates a new version research document with lineage to the prior version.
Accepted support findings that alter promise, scope, or acceptance must route through `beacon-change` / `beacon-change-refreeze`.
